questions.question: ____________ is the highest peak in India.

• **Mount Everest**, while the world's highest peak, is located on the border between **Nepal and the Tibet **Autonomous Region of China, not within India's boundaries.

• **Mount Godwin Austen **(also known as K2) despite being the second highest mountain in the world, is located on the **China-Pakistan border**.
 
• Therefore, within India's current political boundaries, Kanchenjunga holds the title of the highest peak.

questions.question: Due to which scientific phenomenon does a stick, when partly immersed in water, appears to be bent?
questions.solution:
• Refraction of light:- When a ray of light enters a medium from another medium (a denser medium from a rarer medium), it turns towards the normal and after leaving the dense medium, it goes away from the normal, this process is called refraction of light. Example- **a stick, when partly immersed in water, appears to be bent**.
 
• Reflection:- When a ray of light comes out of a source of light and collides with another bright surface and returns to collide, this phenomenon is called reflection of light.

Example: When the laser light is focused on the glass and the beam hits the glass and can be seen elsewhere.

 
• Dispersion: In the optics section of physics, dispersion is a phenomenon in which the velocity of a wave depends on its frequency. Sometimes the term chromatic dispersion is used for specificity.
 
• scattering:- When an atom or molecule comes in contact with light, it absorbs the light energy and emits them in different directions till the light emits, the phenomenon of emitting rays of light is called scattering of light.
